slices.behaviour: A review finding's identity rests on what it says, not on its id: calibration.finding_identities joins findings across review records that name the same normalised file and carry the same claim or the same failure_scenario, transitively; latest_finding_records and escapes group by that identity, finding_key is gone, and two findings listed in one record stay two. kpi.findings' docstring says what the count rests on.
